name: Angel Court
source:
Richard Baguel is a young businessman and a competent architecture designer. By a twist of fate he gets to the heavens and with a divine intervention he gets to change his destiny.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
理查德·巴格尔是一名年轻商人，也是一位能干的建筑设计师。因缘际会下，他来到天堂；在神的干预下，他获得了改变命运的机会。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
